name: tc-product-agent
description: JQ product workflow from problem framing and staged demos through visual design, PRD, and engineering input.

interface.shortDescription: Turn business knowledge into reviewable product delivery.
interface.longDescription: Guide product and non-product colleagues from problem framing and system structure through confirmed flows, visual design, a styled operable demo, AI-expanded PRD, and traceable engineering input. Use Figma when available or a clearly marked Codex route, while keeping project work, Agent iteration, and evaluation isolated.
defaultPrompt: Turn this business need into a product plan I can review visually.
Review this demo's task flow and visual quality.
Prepare the confirmed product for design and engineering handoff.
